rules of the Public Forum will be determined by the Board President, once the
number of people wishing to participate is identified.

f. Discussion and Possible Decision: Resolution to Request Early Start Date for 2027-2028
School Year
Motion to approve request for early start date with the update to the document to say
Mosinee School District
Moved by: Megan Stankowski; seconded by: Donna Kaiser
Carried 9-0
g. Discussion: Board Members and Chain of Command
President Nievinski advises board to be careful to not make promises to community
members and to refer them to follow the proper chain of command. Diane Gorman
reiterated that the position of the board is that they should remain neutral. Jessica Maple
addressed that members with children should remember that they represent all students
in the district and not to just advocate for thier own children.
h. Discussion: Board Members and Conflict of Interest
President Nievinski gave examples of conflicts. Jessica Maple reminded board members
that if they are going to be visiting the buildings, they should notify the superintendent or
building administrator.
